name: Manta

queries.query: Manta Ecuador official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public viewer API
queries.result: Found the official GeoManta municipal viewer, the Manta citizen predial consultation portal, the national cadastral program, and an official municipal report describing active and digitized cadastral units. GeoManta exposed a public WMS/WFS service after following its current JavaScript configuration.

queries.query: Manta Ecuador catastro predial visor geográfico parcelas predios sitio oficial
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial encontró GeoManta de la Alcaldía de Manta, la consulta municipal de impuesto predial y la ordenanza de valoración de predios. El visor carga un servicio WMS/WFS público; la ruta de consulta general es un servicio predial/tributario y no se usó para solicitar datos personales.

registryEvidence.custodian: Gobierno Autónomo Descentralizado Municipal del Cantón Manta, Dirección de Avalúos y Catastro
registryEvidence.basis: The first-party municipal GeoManta viewer and Manta ordinance identify the municipal cadastre/predial system; the public WFS response is served by the GeoManta domain.

officialSources.observation: Official GeoManta viewer; its HTML loads app_geoportal.js and identifies the municipal map application.
officialSources.scope: Manta municipal GeoManta service; city/canton scope is indicated by the first-party host and viewer layers.

officialSources.observation: Manta municipal page describes GeoManta as a free official geographic information tool with updated territorial data.
Municipal report states 93,531 active cadastral units and 81,941 digitized in SIG; this is contextual coverage evidence, not a substitute for the bounded geometry response.

requests.outcome: Fetched official viewer HTML and followed its current JavaScript configuration.

Inspected current code: viewer uses /geoserver-proxy/workspace_geomanta/wms and exposes layer names including geo_predio; its application JSON routes returned an authentication page when called without the viewer session.
Public WMS capabilities returned EPSG:4326 and layer geo_predio.
Public WFS capabilities returned workspace_geomanta:geo_predio, geo_manzana, and geo_predio_juridico.

Schema inspection found native lote_id, clavecatastral, geom, and other fields. Only lote_id, clavecatastral, and geom were requested in the sample; owner, address, tax, and personal fields were not requested or retained.

Bounded anonymous response returned three Polygon features with native lote_id/clavecatastral and EPSG:4326 geometry. The retained sample removes all source properties except canonical id values derived from lote_id.
Returned GeoManta authentication HTML rather than layer JSON; not treated as evidence of absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Manta municipal GeoManta cadastral layers; municipal report provides canton-wide cadastral-unit context.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A bounded WFS bbox around the preserved WUP point returned three parcel polygons; this is local sample evidence, not a complete citywide extract.

remainingUncertainty: The WFS sample proves a public local parcel geometry route and three native identifiers, but does not establish complete citywide availability, update cadence, or adapter robustness. The exact WUP point was preserved; the nearby bbox sample was not used to infer exact-point presence or absence.
